capabilities: Move the cursor with Emacs-style bindings (char, word, line, paragraph, buffer)
Kill, cut and copy regions and paste with yank
Delete, upcase, downcase and capitalize words and selected regions
Repeat held movement and deletion chords with configurable delay and interval
Rescue Alt-composed meta chords on macOS so they trigger bindings
disambiguation: Not a full Emacs implementation or elisp integration; it only adds a set of Emacs-like editing commands and keybindings.
extras: README states this is a fork fixing macOS Alt-key composition and documents known issues: Ctrl+A conflicts with select all, no kill-ring support (recommends a separate plugin for Alt+y), and missing scroll-up/scroll-down commands.
intentEvidence: Basic imitation of Emacs commands to make text editing for Emacs users more smooth
motivation: The author wants text editing in Obsidian to feel smooth for Emacs users via basic imitation of Emacs commands.
problem: Obsidian's default keybindings differ from Emacs conventions, so Emacs users lose muscle memory for cursor movement, deletion and selection commands.

relations.evidence: Basic imitation of Emacs commands to make text editing for Emacs users more smooth

summary: Emacs keybinding emulation plugin that adds commands for Emacs-style cursor movement, killing, yanking and case conversion.
